after.title: Colin et al2013 cubomedusan propulsion
after.scope: Actual complete PDF pp2-4 including Figures1-3 and selected methods/captions inspected. Chironex and Chiropsella panels are separated; Figure6/10 images are Chiropsella, not a Chironex photo. Three consecutive cycles in plotted mean/deviation are not three animals or fitted trajectories. Lewis/Bentlage2009 selected comparative text was read, but new figure retrieval failed. The separate Australian Museum field photograph credited Gavin Dally was privately inspected and linked only; vitality and photographic identification were not independently redetermined; existing Emoke Denes museum photo is preserved, not live colour/motion evidence.
